name: ymarkdowng
description: 可自定义背景与排版的本地 Markdown 笔记编辑器

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts electron *.ts *.json index.html README.md
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:installer: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never

author: Okazaki-Yumemi
